name: Jack Morris
bio: Jack Morris is a British actor trained at Richmond Drama School.

credits.title: Werwulf
credits.overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

credits.title: Tornado
credits.overview: When her father's puppet samurai show gets ambushed by a notorious gang, Tornado vows to seek vengeance and forge her own destiny by stealing their ill-gotten gold.

credits.title: Havoc
credits.overview: When a drug heist swerves lethally out of control, a jaded cop fights his way through a corrupt city's criminal underworld to save a politician's son.

credits.title: The Wasp
credits.overview: Heather bumps into Carla, having not spoken to her in years, and presents her with a very unexpected proposition that could change both of their lives forever.

credits.title: Get Well Soon
credits.overview: Curious as to what life was like before a lockdown that never ceased, a citizen sets out to interview people at their windows along with a cameraman, during the one day people are allowed to leave their homes.

credits.title: Haar
credits.overview: Jef is stranded in Budapest and so spends a day reckoning with past and present lovers, as well as an estranged family, in this gorgeous low-fi indie drama.

credits.title: Into the Deep
credits.overview: Follows a woman desperate to escape her town, she meets a stranger who promises a romantic escape, but it results in deceit, mistrust, and violence.

credits.title: The Guernsey Literary & Potato Peel Pie Society
credits.overview: Free-spirited writer Juliet Ashton forms a life-changing bond with the delightful and eccentric Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society, when she decides to write about the book club they formed during the occupation of Guernsey in WWII.
